author: Author
save_state_title: Save current values to the library (reopen later, searchable by AI)
save_state_timeout: No response from the artifact — try again
refresh_linked_title: Reload data from the linked spreadsheet
docling_legacy: Figure thumbnails from a previous indexing flow are no longer stored. Use the pdf_render_page tool or open the PDF viewer.
data_help: Edit artifact data as a JSON object. Saving replaces the current data.
miniapp_create: What would you like to create?
miniapp_intro: A small app made for you. Keep tasks, explore data, calculate scenarios or bring an idea to life. Start here or imagine something different.
miniapp_placeholder: For example: a project dashboard with tasks, deadlines and a progress chart…
miniapp_handoff_hint: Your idea opens as a draft in Many. Add your data and adjust the details before sending.
miniapp_create_prompt: Create an interactive miniapp that I can save and reuse. My idea: {{idea}}
miniapp_customize_prompt: I want to customize “{{title}}” as an interactive miniapp. Keep its link and data; help me define what to change.
idea_tracker_prompt: A task tracker with priorities, deadlines, filters and progress. I want to add, edit, complete and delete tasks, and keep them when I reopen it.
idea_calculator_prompt: A monthly budget calculator with editable income and expenses, available savings and scenario comparisons. Show the calculation and save my values.
idea_dashboard_prompt: A project dashboard with progress KPIs, filters by project and status, charts and task details. Start without invented data and let me add my own.
idea_synoptic_detail: Explore a process and its KPIs.
idea_synoptic_prompt: An interactive process synoptic with connected nodes. Selecting a node shows its KPIs, status and details. Let me edit values manually and indicate that these are not live readings.
idea_infographic_prompt: An interactive infographic to explore a topic through visual relationships, comparisons and expandable details. Let me add my sources and discover information without reading a long report.
